notes.title: V1.1.7 Update - Typo / Music Error Fix
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed a typo.
[*]Fixed a bug where the battle music could be incorrectly panned.
[/list]

notes.title: V1.1.6 Update - Softlock and graphical fix
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Later in the Lab there was a room where you could softlock yourself, you can still do this, of course, but now MM will just reprimand you and then free you.
[*]A graphical error was fixed in the same room.
[/list]

notes.title: V1.1.5 Update - Bug fix / Typos
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed a couple typos.
[*]A bug where the wrong battle and victory music would play in the crime side quest has been fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: V1.1.4 Update - French Rob Update
notes.content: Rob is now fluent in french.

notes.title: V1.1.3 Update - Bug Patch / Typos
notes.content:
[list]
[*]You can no longer do the Crime side quest if you're a slime.
[*]The Stablinski brothers now attack immediately after you recruit them.
[*]The music in ShopMart would sometimes not play, this bug has been fixed.
[*]If you do the first part of the Crime side quest after you complete the Lab, the dialogue will be slightly different.
[*]The fight music would sometimes play the boss theme during the first Crime side quest fight.
[*]A door had the doorknob on the wrong side, now fixed.
[*]Added a comma to a sentence.
[/list]

notes.title: V1.1.2 Update - Bug Patch / Typos
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed some typos.
[*] Fixed an inconsistency in Rico's Bio.
[*] Made sure that Crimes Johnson correctly retells the tale of Icarus, because apparently Icarus actually fell into the sea and not onto the ground.
[/list]

notes.title: V1.1.1 Crime sidequest crash fix
notes.content: [p]There was a missing image file that caused one of the cutscenes in the new sidequest to crash, don't know how I missed that but it should be fixed now.[/p]

notes.title: V1.1.1 - The King of Crime update! Part 2!
notes.content: [p]These are the last little bits that where intended for the V1.1.0 update.[/p][list][*][p]Couple bug fixes.[/p][/*][*][p]New bio has been added to the bios room.[/p][/*][*][p]Some bios will now be locked until you complete certain side quests.[/p][/*][*][p]There's a new ending if you didn't drink the green vial in the lab.[/p][/*][*][p]Altered some dialogue in the ??? room to be more ambiguous.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: V1.1.0 - The King of Crime update!
notes.content: [p]The 1.1.0 update is now here! (Don't ask what happened to to 1.0.9)[/p][list][*][p]A large side quest has been added with new characters, and fights.[/p][/*][*][p]Some new rooms have been added to the title screen, that you can observe if you've beaten the game.[/p][/*][/list][p]This update might be a little buggy so please report any issues you find.[/p][p]Also there are still a couple little things left that will be added after this.[/p]

notes.title: V1.0.8 Update - Bug Patch
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Knocked out party members will now earn 100% EXP from fights.
[*]MM has been rebalanced again.
[*]The cutscene right after the final boss has been reworked to remove the p******** joke, although this might be disappointing to some of you, it was the only joke in the game that pushed the game’s contents to 18+ which has led to other complications and I’d rather just remove the joke then deal with that.
[/list]

notes.title: V1.0.7 Update - Bug Patch
notes.content:
[list]
[*]WASD controls have been added
[*]The Beast (Vengeful) now has a new skill
[*]Your money will now be set back to what it was before the battle, after you retry
[*]You can no longer lock yourself out of getting the fire skates in the Democracy Lair
[*]You can now adjust the volume by 10% rather then 20%
[*]Default Master Volume is now 50%
[*]Updated plugin credits
[/list]

notes.title: V1.0.6 Update - Bug Patch
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added more candles to the main menu at Atlus’s request
[*]Slightly decreased MindMasterer’s attack
[*]Changed the music when Gorganox becomes a secretary
[*]
Fixed a bug in the Democracy Lair where you would get teleported into an old room and be softlocked
[*]Removed some instances of Rico being called kid (since people were getting confused about his age, he’s 25)
[*]Decreased Crooks Dastardly’s attack
[*]Added water to the first Fire Monkey room
[*]Extra text has been added to Figglebeard’s desk
[*]Figglebeard now drinks his protein shake slightly faster
[*]Fixed a bug where you could get behind the car in the final manor chase
[/list]

notes.title: V1.0.4 Update - Bug Patch
notes.content:
[list]
[*]The Janitor’s hat now has -75% aggro.
[*]Mindmasterer’s attack has been slightly decreased.
[*]The Rejuvenator now only takes 100HP.
[*]Fire Skates are no longer sold in ShopMart.
[*]The final boss’s attacks are now dodge-able.
[*]The Sunglasses description has been changed.
[*]If you die and retry twice you’ll be asked if you want to lower the difficulty.
[/list]

notes.title: V1.0.4 Update - Bug Patch
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Updated the Plugin Credits.
[*]Pressing cancel when talking to Easy Eegen will no longer lower the difficulty.
[*]Added a new event if you keep interacting with the dumpster.
[*]Master Volume is now set to 80% by default.
[/list]

notes.title: V1.0.3 Update - Bug Patch
notes.content: There was a way to soft-lock yourself in the final area, this has been fixed.

notes.title: V1.0.2 Update - Bug Patch
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Disabled the menu that would pop up after pressing F12.
[*]Updated the Plugin Credits.
[*]Fixed Display Donuts, they now actually target enemies and also deal more damage.
[/list]

notes.title: V1.0.1 Update - Bug Patch
notes.content:
Updated an old Ruins sprite.
Tweaked Figglebeard fight.
The Edgy T-Shirt is now available at ShopMart after beating the Castle.
Removed the Gun equipment slot from the Bomb Rat’s inventory.
Fixed a typo in the lab.
A different portrait can now appear during the final boss during some optional dialogue.
The player now automatically enters the manor after unlocking the front door.
You can now only try to open the manor’s front door from the inside, while facing down.
Tweaked some dialogue in the Democracy Lair.
Moved some spikes in the Democracy Lair.
Fixed and tweaked sprites in the final area.
Fixed some buttons in the final area.
Fixed some inconsistent capitalization.
Tweaked some dialogue in the final area.
Tweaked Trail Mix description.
Fixed a bug in one of the final area’s cutscenes where Ms. President wouldn’t move to the right tile.
Fixed one of the skills that didn’t work properly in the final boss.
Multiple fights would break if you tried to retry them; these have been fixed.
Added a version marker to the title screen.
Fixed a bug where playtime was recorded through your fps, so if it wasn’t consistently 60 it would record it inaccurately.
[list]
[*]If you try saving with a file from V1.0.0, the displayed time will break. (Sorry)
[/list]
